blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The national government’s budget deficit nearly doubled to P161.3 billion in August, driven by a sharp spending increase amid large budgetary support for the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth). Latest data from the Bureau of the Treasury showed the August budget deficit was 90.23 percent wider than the P84.8 billion shortfall recorded in the same month last year. READ: PH July budget deficit widens 462% to P 106.3B This pushed the year-to-date budget deficit to P1.05 trillion, still within the national government’s P1.658-trillion full-year program.
